text:
frank: Heads up - nightly invoice run bill-2026-04-05 produced a duplicate for customer 'KeelWorks' (cust_778). inv_231111A = $27,300, inv_231111B = $24,800. The smaller one is missing a proration adjustment (proration: $2,500). Job: run-8330. @finance @billing-team

billing-bot: automated retry triggered after PDF timeout; created inv_231111B as retry.

nina: quick DB check: ```SELECT id, amount_cents, line_items, metadata->>'job_run' FROM invoices WHERE customer_id='cust_778' AND created_at > '2026-04-05';```
Result:
- inv_231111A | 2730000 | [{usage:2500000, proration:250000, tax:0}] | run=run-8330
- inv_231111B | 2480000 | [{usage:2480000}]               | run=run-8330-retry

julia: logs show worker failed with "WriteTimeout: sendto()" when generating PDF at 02:13:08 then retried. The retry path creates a new invoice record but the attach_proration() step has a guard `if attached_by_run(job_run): skip` which mistakenly treats retry as different and skips recalculation. File: billing/adjustments/proration.py:142.

frank: Any payments captured? Client is asking about lower amount on the second invoice.

acct-bot: payment status: both uncaptured. No charges to capture or refund.

nina: Proposed quick/actions: 1) pause exporter for run-8330; 2) mark inv_231111B voided with note 'auto-duplicate: missing proration on retry SPT-1678'; 3) reissue corrected invoice inv_231111C. Need accounting approval to void.

julia: I'll open a PR to make attach_proration idempotent (upsert by invoice_id, code) and add unique constraint on invoice_lines(code) to prevent duplicates. Also change retry semantics so retries reuse same invoice record instead of creating a new one.

frank: I approve voiding inv_231111B (uncaptured). Nina, please add SPT-1678 to the note and link the support ticket.

nina: drafting customer message: "Hi KeelWorks - we found a billing automation issue where a retry created a duplicate invoice missing a proration line. We'll void the duplicate (inv_231111B) and reissue the corrected invoice today. No action required on your side."

julia: PR: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/467 - changes idempotency for proration attach, adds unique constraint, and updates retry to reuse invoice id. Planning staging deploy in 45m.

ops: paused exporter for run-8330 and created ENG-BILL-972. Backfill scan across batch shows 3 other customers had retry-created duplicates but their proration lines attached correctly; only cust_778 missing proration.

frank: good catch. Nina - please wait 15m then run void update: ```UPDATE invoices SET status='voided', note='auto-duplicate: missing proration on retry; see SPT-1678' WHERE id='inv_231111B';```

nina: will run after 15m unless someone objects. Also setting note on inv_231111A with ticket link and audit entry.

billing-bot: suppressing further automated reruns for cust_778 until patch deployed.

frank: thanks all. tagging for month-end audit and reconciliation. :thumbsup:
